title: Get items under negotiation ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') — get_items
text: topic (Thema) Character vector NULL. Specifies topic(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. institution Character string. Either "NR" (Nationalrat, National Council) "BR" (Bundesrat, Federal Council). Default NULL returns chambers. legis_period Character vector NULL. Specifies legislative period(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. date_start Character string. Start date search period format "dd-mm-yyyy", "dd.mm.yyyy", "dd/mm/yyyy". Default NULL. date_end Character string. End date search period format "dd-mm-yyyy", "dd.mm.yyyy", "dd/mm/yyyy". Default NULL. item (Gegenstand) Character vector NULL. Specifies type(s) parliamentary item(s) search . See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. type_doc (Art des Antrages / Art der Anfrage) Character vector NULL. Specifies document type certain item types. Permissible values depend item institution. See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. type_eu_submission (Art der EU-Vorlage) Character vector NULL. Type(s) EU submission search . Can specified item = "EU". See 'Details' possible values. Default NULL. person Character string NULL. Name person search (family name, optionally followed first name). Default NULL. keyword Character vector NULL. Keyword(s) search . Default NULL. eurovoc Character vector NULL. EuroVoc term(s) search . Default NULL. parl_group Character vector NULL. Parliamentary group(s) search . Default NULL. Combine multiple groups vector, .e. c("SPÖ", "ÖVP"). See Details. parl_group_names_standard Logical. TRUE, function expands standardizes parliamentary group names. Default FALSE. See Details. echo Logical. TRUE, function prints used search parameters url pertaining search results website Austrian Parliament.

title: Get items under negotiation ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') — get_items
text: tibble (data.frame) one row per parliamentary item matching search. returned object contains commonly used columns (optional returned list-columns multi-valued fields): - legis_period (character): legislative period (e.g. "XXVIII"). institution (character): chamber code, typically "NR" (Nationalrat) "BR" (Bundesrat). date (Date): date item (class Date). item_type (character): short item type code. item_number (character): numeric identifier item (stored character). item_number_type (character): combined number/type string (e.g. "46/M"). stage (character/integer): current stage code item. item_url (character): normalized URL pointing item parlament.gv.. type_doc (character): short document type code (applicable). type_doc_long (character): human readable document type (available). subject (character): subject / title item. topics (list): list-column; element character vector topics. keywords (list): list-column keywords (Schlagwort). eurovoc (list): list-column EuroVoc terms. persons (list): list-column person identifiers (pad_intern) related item. parl_group (list): list-column parliamentary group codes associated item.

title: Get items under negotiation ('Verhandlungsgegenstände') — get_items
text: Austrian Parliament API imposes maximum limit 100,000 rows per query. query reaches limit, function issues warning results may incomplete. Strategies handle large result sets: Refine search criteria (narrower date ranges, specific topics, individual legislative periods) Split queries multiple requests combine results using purrr::map() purrr::list_rbind() Example splitting legislative period:
code: library(purrr)  # Query items for multiple legislative periods separately periods <- c(25, 26, 27, 28) all_results <- periods %>%   map(\(period) get_items(legis_period = period, echo = FALSE)) %>%   list_rbind()

title: Get mandates — get_mandates
text: Takes one multiple names pad_interns input returns dataframe past present mandates. Mandates can limited specific date institution. Mandates cover memberships Parliament, also executive (e.g. Bundeskanzler/Chancellor). Note single row returned dataframe can represent e.g. multiple mandates e.g. Nationalrat consecutively held. function partly mimics behavior 'Personensuche' website Parliament ().

title: Get mandates — get_mandates
code: get_mandates(name = NULL, pad_intern = NULL, institution = NULL, date = NULL)

title: Get mandates — get_mandates
text: name character vector name(s). First name followed family name. combined pad_intern; one two must provided. pad_intern Personal identfication number person(s). combined name; one two must provided. institution Chamber Parliament. "NR" (Nationalrat), "BR" (Bundesrat), "KN" (Konstituierende Nationalversammlung), "PN" (Provisorische Nationalversammlung). NULL covers institutions. Note e.g. "NR" return MP's mandates, also presidents National Council, Secretaries ("Schriftführer"), Regulators ("Ordner"). equivalent applies chambers well. date Date filter mandates (dmy format).

title: Get Members of Parliament — get_mps
text: get_mps() retrieves information Members Parliament based specified filter criteria. function mirrors search functionality 'Parlamentarier:innen ab 1918' (Parliamentarians since 1918) Austrian Parliament website .

title: Get Members of Parliament — get_mps
code: get_mps(   search_string = NULL,   institution = NULL,   gender = "all",   legis_period = NULL,   date = NULL,   party = NULL,   parl_group = NULL,   state = NULL,   electoral_district = NULL,   presidents_only = NULL,   echo = TRUE )

title: Get Members of Parliament — get_mps

title: Get Members of Parliament — get_mps
text: dataframe containing information MPs. One row per MP. Important: API returns details MPs e.g. member Parliament requested legislative period. details returned, however, limited requested period. column parl_group may also contain data MP's membership parliamentary group requested period, also also membership parliamentary groups past. Columns returned: pad_intern: Person's unique identification number date: Requested date (included date input provided) name: Name MP gender: Gender (male, female) parl_group: Parliamentary group; note groups stated comprises past present groups MP member parl_group_abbrev: Abbreviation parliamentary group legis_period: Legislative period(s) mandate_detail: Details mandates Parliament queried period time (mandates). obtain mandates, use get_mandates(). electoral_district: Electoral district

title: Get Members of Parliament — get_mps
text: Filtering legislative period possible National Council (Nationalrat), Constituent National Assembly (Konstituierende Nationalversammlung), Provisional National Assembly (Provisorische Nationalversammlung). Including legislative period argument exclude results Federal Council (Bundesrat) since composition #' follows different electoral cycles. Providing 'legis_period' input return one row per unique combination MP legislative period. list-column 'mp_details' contains mandate details MP specified legislative period. Since MP can change within single legislative period, example, family name, party affiliation, parliamentary group, electoral district mandate, 'mp_details' may include multiple rows reflecting changes.

what: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
text: function retrieves details Members Parliament (MPs) three categories: speeches held plenary meetings ("plenary"), relevant activities ("activities"), participation committees ("committees"). Depending requested details category, different function parameters available. example data source website Austrian Parliament, see different tabs e.g., .

title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
code: get_mps_details(   pad_intern,   detail_type,   institution = NULL,   legis_period = NULL,   item = NULL,   search_string = NULL,   committee = NULL,   committee_position = NULL,   echo = TRUE )

title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
text: pad_intern ID MP. Vector length 1. See get_pad_intern() details. detail_type Character string specifying type details retrieve: "plenary", "activities", "committees". examples see :  plenary ; activities; committees. institution Character string specifying parliamentary house. Permissible inputs "NR" (Nationalrat/National Council), "BR" (Bundesrat/Federal Council ) NULL (returns results houses). Defaults NULL. legis_period Numeric character vector specifying one legislative periods (optional). Accepts numeric values (e.g., 27 c(26, 27)), Roman numerals (e.g., "XXVII"), historical abbreviations. Must >= 20 valid periods. Defaults NULL. item Character string specifying item type (Art des Verhandlungsgegenstandes) (optional). Defaults NULL. Used details category "activities". See Details . search_string Character string searching within activities (optional). Defaults NULL. Currently implemented details category "activities". committee Character string specifying committee name (optional). detail_type == "committees". See Details section valid committee names. committee_position Character string specifying committee position (optional). detail_type == "committees". Common values include "Mitglied", "Vorsitzende/r", "Stellvertretende/r Vorsitzende/r". echo Logical indicating whether print API request response details. Defaults TRUE.

title: Get detailed information about Members of Parliament — get_mps_details
text: data frame containing requested MP details. structure depends detail_type parameter: detail_type = "plenary": Returns speeches person specified house, regardless mandate time speech. example, querying plenary activities Doris Bures National Council return speeches MP, also President National Council Minister. Columns returned: pad_intern: Unique identifier MP name: Full name MP position_name: List mandates/positions held time speech date: Date speech legis_period: Legislative period (Roman numeral) institution: Chamber Parliament: "NR" (National Council) "BR" (Federal Council) speech_title: Title speech meeting_url: URL meeting details page meeting_name: Name parliamentary meeting speech_transcript_url: URL speech transcript speech_media_url: URL speech recordings, available detail_type = "activities": Returns parliamentary activities legislative items associated MP. Columns returned: pad_intern: Unique identifier MP legis_period: Legislative period institution: Chamber Parliament: "NR" (National Council) "BR" (Federal Council) frmdate: Date field ityp_komm: Item type comment item_number: Number parliamentary item item_type: Type parliamentary item (e.g., "", "JMIN") title: Title/subject item date_updated: Last update date item item_url: URL item details status_text: Current status description status_numeric: Numeric status code detail_type = "committees": Returns committee memberships participation. Columns returned: pad_intern: Unique identifier MP name: Full name MP legis_period: Legislative period committee_name: Name committee committee_position: Position committee (e.g., "Mitglied", "Vorsitzende/r") institution: Chamber Parliament: "NR" (National Council) "BR" (Federal Council) committee_position_start: Start date committee membership committee_position_end: End date committee membership (NA still active) committee_active: Logical indicating membership currently active committee_url: URL committee details Returns NULL invisibly data found given parameters.

title: Get Participation Data from Austrian Parliament — get_participation
text: function sends request Austrian Parliament's API retrieve participation data based provided filter criteria. performs input validation parameter constructs API request accordingly. Valid values topic: "Arbeit" (Labor) "Außenpolitik" (Foreign Policy) "Bildung" (Education) "Budget und Finanzen" (Budget Finance) "Europäische Union" (European Union) "Familie und Generationen" (Family Generations) "Frauen und Gleichbehandlung" (Women Equal Treatment) "Gesundheit und Ernährung" (Health Nutrition) "Information und Medien" (Information Media) "Inneres und Recht" (Interior Justice) "Innovation, Technologie und Forschung" (Innovation, Technology Research) "Klima, Umwelt und Energie" (Climate, Environment Energy) "Kultur" (Culture) "Land- und Forstwirtschaft" (Agriculture Forestry) "Landesverteidigung" (National Defense) "Parlament und Demokratie" (Parliament Democracy) "Soziales" (Social Affairs) "Sport" (Sports) "Verkehr und Infrastruktur" (Transport Infrastructure) "Wirtschaft" (Economy) Setting topic = NULL returns values topics listed . Valid values item: "RGES" (Gesetzesinitiativen / Legislative Initiatives) "" (Ministerialentwürfe / Ministerial Drafts) "BI" (Bürgerinitiativen / Citizens' Initiatives) "PET" (Petitionen / Petitions) "SN" (Stellungnahmen / Statements) Setting item = NULL returns values review types listed . Valid values initiative_type (item=="RGES"): "" (Gesetzesanträge von Abgeordneten / Legislative Motions Members) "BUA" (Gesetzesanträge von Ausschüssen / Legislative Motions Committees) "RV" (Regierungsvorlagen / Government Bills) Setting initiative_type = NULL returns values initiative types listed . Valid values statement_type (item=="SN"): "SNME" (Stellungnahme Ministerialentwurf / Statement Ministerial Draft) "SN" (Stellungnahme Gesetzesinitiative / Statement Legislative Initiative) "SPET" (Stellungnahme zur Petition / Statement Petition) "SPET-BR" (Stellungnahme zur Petition Bundesrat / Statement Petition Federal Council) "SBI" (Stellungnahme Bürgerinitiative / Statement Citizens' Initiative) Setting statement_type = NULL returns values statement types listed .

title: Get Details of a Plenary Meeting — get_plenary_meeting_details
text: url Character NULL. URL plenary meeting page parlament.gv.. Can absolute URL (without ?selectedStage= query parameter) relative path. selectedStage parameter ignored fetching data — selectedStage=100 selectedStage=110 return embedded dataset. Mutually exclusive institution, legis_period, meeting_number. institution Character NULL. Parliamentary chamber: "NR" (Nationalrat) "BR" (Bundesrat). Mutually exclusive url. legis_period Character, numeric, NULL. Legislative period. Accepts numeric (28), Arabic character ("28"), Roman numeral ("XXVIII") formats. Mutually exclusive url. meeting_number Character, numeric, NULL. Meeting number within legislative period (e.g. 50 "50"). Mutually exclusive url. details_on Character NULL. Specifies part meeting data return. NULL (default), returns 1-row tibble meeting metadata. Use "speakers" return multi-row tibble one row per speech, including timing information. Use "decisions" return multi-row tibble one row per agenda item (TOP). Use "timeline" return multi-row tibble one row per Sitzungsverlauf event. echo Logical. TRUE, prints URL fetched number rows returned. Default FALSE.

title: Get Data on Plenary Meetings of the Austrian Parliament — get_plenary_meetings
text: Retrieves information plenary meetings Austrian Parliament's API (see ). Data available 20th legislative period onwards.

title: Get Data on Plenary Meetings of the Austrian Parliament — get_plenary_meetings
code: get_plenary_meetings(   institution = NULL,   legis_period = NULL,   meeting_and_activities = NULL,   session_type = NULL,   meeting_type = NULL,   echo = FALSE )

title: Get Data on Plenary Meetings of the Austrian Parliament — get_plenary_meetings
text: institution character string specifying institution. "BR" (Bundesrat/Federal Council), "NR" (Nationalrat/National Council), "BV" (Bundesversammlung/Federal Assembly). legis_period Numeric value vector specifying legislative period(s). Can also NULL retrieve periods 20th onwards. Must NULL institution "BV" (Bundesversammlung use legislative periods). meeting_and_activities character string. One 'meetings' 'activities'. 'meetings' returns plenary meeting entries; 'activities' returns parliamentary items submitted acted upon meetings. applicable institution "BV" (Bundesversammlung); must NULL BV institution. session_type character string vector. Filter meeting period type. Permissible values: "N" (Ordentliche Tagung / Ordinary session), "" (Ausserordentliche Tagung / Extraordinary session). Can NULL retrieve meeting period types. applicable institution "BV". meeting_type character string vector. Filter sitting type. Permissible values: "S" (Sitzung / Regular sitting), "" (Sondersitzung / Special sitting), "ZU" (Zuweisungssitzung / Assignment sitting), "N" (Nachtrag / Addendum). title: Retrieve Transcripts from the Austrian Parliament API — get_transcripts
text: search_string Optional character string filter transcripts keywords. Defaults NULL. legis_period Legislative period(s). Default NULL queries legislative periods. Accepts numeric (10), character ("10") roman numerals character format ("X") well "KN" (Konstituierende Nationalversammlung) "PN" (Provisorische Nationalversammlung). meeting_type Optional character string specifying type(s) meeting. Permissible values "NRSITZ" (National Council - Plenary meetings) "BRSITZ" (Federal Council - Plenary meetings). Defaults NULL, queries NRSITZ BRSITZ. See Details information. date_start Optional start date filtering transcripts. Defaults NULL. Date dmy-format (e.g. "01.05.2020", "01/05/2020", "01-05-2020", "01052020"). date_end Optional end date filtering transcripts. Defaults NULL. Date dmy-format (e.g. "01.05.2020", "01/05/2020", "01-05-2020", "01052020"). echo Logical. TRUE, function prints used search parameters url pertaining search results website Austrian Parliament. Default NULL. export Optional character string enable PDF downloads. Set "pdf" download transcript PDFs. Defaults NULL (export). export_destination Character string specifying directory path PDFs saved. Defaults "transcripts" (folder current working directory). folder exist, user prompted create interactive meetings.
